HockeyAllsvenskan Player leaderboard

Source: R/ha.R
ha_leaders.Rd

Current-season top 25 of one metric, with the StatNet player id (the only stats route that has one).

The current season's top 25 of one metric. The only stats route with a player id: player_statnet_id (StatNet player id). team_statnet_id is the StatNet team id and team_code the display code; metric_value stays character (a count for TP, a clock for TOI/GP). The call is refused as truncated unless the board is one complete page.

Usage

ha_leaders(
  metric,
  phase = "HA",
  team = NULL,
  is_goalkeeper = NULL,
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

metric

Leaderboard metric. Seen on the site: TP, G, A, PlusMinus, Hits, FOPerc, TOI/GP (skaters).

phase

Game type: HA regular season, HAPlayoff playoffs, HAkval playout (relegation series). Allowed: HA, HAPlayoff, HAkval.

team

Team filter; omitted = the whole league (values not probed). NULL = not sent.

is_goalkeeper

True for a goalkeeper metric. NULL = not sent.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list (stamped with the request under _request where the body does not say what it answers).

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
rankintegerRank in the table.
player_namecharacterPlayer name (the table carries no player id).
team_codecharacterDisplay code of the team (AIK, MoDo, MORA, NVIF, ÖIK), not the StatNet id.
team_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id (AIK, MODO, MIK, NYB, OSIK), not the display code.
jersey_numberintegerJersey number of the player.
positioncharacterPlaying position: F forward, D defence (G goalkeeper on goalie metrics).
metriccharacterMetric code (echo of the request metric).
metric_valuecharacterValue of the metric (a count, a percentage or a clock, as text).
player_statnet_idintegerStatNet player id (the same id space as SHL's isa id, verified on one player).
first_namecharacterFirst name of the player.
family_namecharacterFamily name of the player.
slugcharacterPlayer slug; joins ha_players.
headshotcharacterHeadshot URL (medium rendition).
headshot_smallcharacterSmall headshot URL.
headshot_mediumcharacterMedium headshot URL.
team_logocharacterLogo URL of the player's team.
team_namecharacterTeam label as shown on the card (the display team code).
team_main_colorcharacterTeam primary colour (hex).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the site has nothing for the request (a season before 2005/06, an unknown or pre-2025/26 game, a phase not played, a body without rows). fastRhockey_bad_request: a value outside its enumerated set, a field the site requires is missing, or HTTP 400/422. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, or an empty, non-JSON, error-shaped, truncated or out-of-scope 200 (the answer is unknown, not empty).

See also

Other HA Functions: ha_game(), ha_games(), ha_goalie_stats(), ha_pbp(), ha_players(), ha_schedule(), ha_skater_stats(), ha_standings(), ha_team_stats(), ha_teams()
